title: pvAlignImageOrigins
body:
## pvAlignImageOrigins

Gives every image block of a composite (multiblock or partitioned) image dataset the same origin and rewrites each block's extent relative to it, so blocks that are parts of one image share a global index space and extent-based operations such as extractSubset behave consistently across blocks. All images must have the same spacing; the shared origin is the minimum corner of all blocks, shifted so that corner gets index MinimumExtent. Point positions do not change.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Blocks with different spacing cannot be aligned; ParaView reports an error.
- Blocks whose origins are not offset by whole multiples of the spacing cannot keep their positions; the native code reports them as misaligned.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AlignImageOrigins`. Identity: `filters/AlignImageOrigin`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
